item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 4:15 PM, 26 October 2026(Monday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bulacan (Pulilan, Calumpit, Plaridel, Malolos, Paombong, Hagonoy, Baliuag, San Rafael, Bustos, Pandi, Balagtas, Bulakan, and Guiguinto), Nueva Ecija (San Antonio and Cabiao), Pampanga (Arayat, Magalang, Mabalacat, Angeles, Santa Ana, Candaba, San Luis, San Simon, Mexico, San Fernando, Apalit, Masantol, Macabebe, Minalin, Santo Tomas, Bacolor, Guagua, Santa Rita, and Sasmuan), Quezon (Buenavista, Catanauan, Lopez, General Luna, Macalelon, Gumaca, Calauag, Guinayangan, Tagkawayan, Atimonan, Plaridel, Pitogo, Unisan, and Agdangan), and Tarlac (Concepcion, Tarlac City, La Paz, Bamban, and Capas) within the next 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
